text.p: Bitstream Inc said Tuesday president and chief executive officer C. Raymond Boelig has been appointed to the additional position of chairman of the board, effective immediately.
He succeeds Amos Kaminski as chairman of the board, who will continue serving on Bitstream's board as chairman of the executive committee.
The company also said it has been granted a U.S. patent for its Bitstream TrueDoc Technology, a font compression and portability solution for hardware and software developers.
This new TrueDoc patent is one of four U.S. patents Bitstream holds for its font technology, the company noted.
